label: Mere-conservation rival of universal perfection transfer survives, checked
description: Rival test for universal perfection transfer against its smallest consumer, CausalPerfectionTransfer.reconstruction (premises: universal perfection transfer, residual transfer). With a universal source of esse and a secondary cause that alone causes a further perfection, the mere-conservation rival holds with the residual condition and the unrestricted transfer principle fails. Model-witnessed survival only; the existing four-role secondary-only interpretation does not satisfy the residual condition, so a new interpretation is used.

research_comparisons.conditions: Control.conserveAct and conserveCause with esse = false: the rival and ResidualPerfectionTransfer hold; CauseOfBeingCausesEveryPerfection fails. Consumer tested: CausalPerfectionTransfer.reconstruction.
research_comparisons.scope: Same InAct, CausesIn and esse as the premise; three members, two respects.
research_comparisons.coverage: One explicitly populated interpretation; the residual condition holds vacuously there.
research_comparisons.exclusivity: The rival and the premise cannot both hold on one InAct, CausesIn and esse (unregistered helper mereConservation_excludes).
research_comparisons.witness: Control.Tier with conserveAct and conserveCause in Control.MereConservationSurvives; mereConservationSurvives proves the listed conjuncts.
research_comparisons.next_step: Test the rival against the premise that a thing's perfections are had only insofar as it has being, under the recorded meaning of causal responsibility.
